@graph.name: How to Hire a Senior Website Developer
@graph.description: A step-by-step guide to hiring a senior website developer for your custom, fast, SEO-optimized website project.

step.name: Define your website scope and performance requirements
step.text: Specify: page count, CMS needs, e-commerce/booking/membership features, target Lighthouse score (90+ recommended), WCAG accessibility level, languages, and timeline.

step.name: Choose the right technology stack
step.text: Next.js App Router for performance-critical sites. Headless CMS (Sanity/Contentful/Strapi) for content management. SSG for marketing sites, ISR for e-commerce, SSR for personalized content.

step.name: Evaluate portfolio with performance evidence
step.text: Ask for Lighthouse reports from previous projects. Test live sites on mobile PageSpeed Insights. Verify JSON-LD structured data in page source. Check axe DevTools accessibility score.

step.name: Agree on deliverables and CMS training
step.text: Define: Figma files, GitHub source code transfer, CMS editor documentation, GA4 + Search Console setup, Lighthouse audit report, WCAG report, and 60-day bug warranty.

step.name: Milestone-based development with weekly demos
step.text: Use milestone contracts: design approval → homepage build → inner pages → CMS integration → SEO/performance pass → launch. Weekly Loom demos on staging environment.

step.name: Launch, handover, and maintenance plan
step.text: Final deliverables: deployed site, GitHub repo, CMS training session, documentation, Lighthouse report. Agree on maintenance retainer ($499/mo+) for security updates and performance monitoring.

mainEntity.name: What is the Core Web Vitals optimization checklist for a fast website?

acceptedAnswer.text: LCP < 2.5s: next/image WebP/AVIF, preload hero, CDN. CLS < 0.1: explicit image dimensions, reserve dynamic content space. INP < 200ms: code-split routes, defer non-critical JS, use React Server Components. Lighthouse CI gates in GitHub Actions.

mainEntity.name: When should I use Next.js App Router vs headless WordPress?

acceptedAnswer.text: Next.js for performance/SEO priority, custom functionality, and full code ownership. Headless WordPress when team knows WP admin and has existing content. Hybrid (WP CMS + Next.js frontend) gives WP editing UX with Next.js performance.

mainEntity.name: What technical SEO is included in a professional website build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Included: semantic HTML, JSON-LD on all page types, canonical tags, XML sitemap, robots.txt, OpenGraph/Twitter Cards, HTTPS, Core Web Vitals optimization, Search Console setup. Extra: keyword research, content strategy, link building, Google Ads.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical website project timeline by scope?

acceptedAnswer.text: 5-page business site: 2–3 weeks. CMS business site: 3–5 weeks from $2,999. E-commerce: 5–8 weeks from $5,999. Membership/booking: 6–10 weeks. Multilingual: add 1–2 weeks per language.
